mintAuthority.summary: Canonical Ethereum USDx has two live MARKET_ROLE holders: USDxMarket and the 3-of-5 governance Safe. The Safe can call token mint directly without market capacity or collateral checks, as well as administer roles, routes and capacity. Proxy upgrades separately require a two-day timelock whose proposer and executor are the same Safe. Offchain reconciliation and key independence remain unverified.

controls.label: Axis USDxMarket canonical issuer
controls.capDescription: Signed orders must pass account eligibility, signer, enabled route/channel, nonce and configured CapConfig capacity checks. Exact current cap amounts and complete latent route closure are not asserted.

sources.label: USDxMarket signed-order settlement and capacity checks

controls.evidence: At block 26107703, USDx.hasRole(MARKET_ROLE, USDxMarket) returned true. Official documentation identifies the market as the live launch issuance route and documents cap-limited atomic settlement of user-signed orders. The market does not independently value collateral through an external price oracle. Future BRIDGE_ROLE assignment is an admin expansion surface, not an authored active bridge deployment.

controls.label: Axis published mint operator
controls.capDescription: Executes approved signed mint orders under USDxMarket capacity and routing constraints; exact cap values remain unreviewed.
controls.evidence: USDxMarket.hasRole(MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE, this published wallet) returned true at block 26107703. Complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history from deployment through block 26110188 identifies this as the sole current mint operator, corroborated by hasRole. Docs call it KMS-secured; no independent HSM/MPC key-custody attestation was retrieved. It executes signed settlement, while the governance Safe separately retains direct token mint authority.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26110188, complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history and hasRole confirm this Safe holds both DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MARKET_ROLE on USDx. The verified deployed USDx.mint(address,uint256) only checks MARKET_ROLE and transfer restrictions: this path bypasses signed orders and market caps. getThreshold=3, getOwners lists the same five owners, complete getModulesPaginated(0x1,100) terminates empty, and the standard guard slot is zero. The fallback-handler slot is 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99, whose exact bypass reach remains unreviewed. Signer independence is not established.

At block 26110188, complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history since deployment identifies DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE only on the timelock itself and PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE only on governance Safe 0xdeb538917b1c1ae6b81550a6c42a66d818cc6d6d; each active membership was corroborated by hasRole. getMinDelay=172800. The implementation is 0x7c4ba7477f180b0370338f722c3717b3fbfda1c6; its sole activation was the July 23 deployment. This delay does not constrain direct Safe minting or role grants.

review.evidence: The deployment-to-block-26110188 event census confirms the Safe is sole DEFAULT_ADMIN on token, market and MarketConfig; MARKET_ROLE has both market and Safe; MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE has only 0xdeca86926d2aec9c3b0eeeb54aacfde6d0249370; BRIDGE_ROLE has no grants. Timelock proposer/executor/canceller are the Safe, with self-only admin and 172800-second delay. Current hasRole and Safe quorum calls corroborate the census. Direct uncapped Safe token minting contradicts the documentation's market-only assertion, so global issuance is unbounded despite market-specific capacities. Accountable reporting does not establish full issuance-ledger reconciliation or prudential supervision. The known fallback handler has not received execution-complete review; no bypass exclusion or human-independence credit is claimed. Its exact verified deployed source identifies the standard Safe CompatibilityFallbackHandler; with no enabled modules or standard guard detected, that generic noninterference question is not a separate mint-identity gap. Independent signer/key-custody evidence remains unavailable. Current market capacities and configurable latent route inventory remain unpinned and are scoped to USDxMarket; they do not bound direct Safe minting.
unresolvedQuestions: What are the exact current USDxMarket capacities and complete configurable latent route inventory? Full deployed market execution/configuration closure is not established by the current role census and issuer documentation; these gaps do not bound the independently verified direct Safe token-mint path.
